I interpret that "cookies" exists in this requirement as one example of source of user input. For me it's ok that way.

> I propose removing "cookies" in this requirement because it does not make sense whitelisting cookies as they will always change in value every authenticated session

With this sentence - maybe you take one situation and watch it too general. I'm not agree with phrase "they will always change in value every authenticated session" for ALL cookies. It's really limited to session cookie.

Additionally - how to interpret whitelisting? I don't watch it as whitelist of values, but whitelist of patterns - allowed characters, min/max length, format etc
